item.description: Automatic positioning: Children are automatically assigned to rows and columns
Dynamic row generation: Rows are created automatically based on the number of children
Uniform row heights: All rows share the same height defined by
Column-specific alignment: Use for per-column content alignment
Automatic relayout: Updates automatically when children are added or removed
Define to specify the number and width of columns
Set to define a uniform height for all rows
Add child elements - they are automatically arranged in grid cells

remarks.para: This invoker performs no thread marshalling and executes all delegates synchronously on the calling thread. It's the default implementation used when no other invoker is registered with the singleton container.

item.description: Synchronous execution: All delegates execute immediately on the calling thread
No marshalling: Does not switch threads or use dispatchers
Type safety: Validates return types and null handling for function delegates
Default implementation: Used as fallback when no other invoker is configured
Console applications where thread marshalling is not needed
Unit testing scenarios
Background operations that don't interact with UI
Default fallback when no dispatcher-based invoker is available
